Rules.InvariantScript:
Set(
    resolvedMessage,
    Index(
        [
            "Thank you for helping keep the community safe, " & vResponderName & ".",
            "Your response made a difference today, " & vResponderName & ".",
            "Emergency resolved. Support delivered by " & vResponderName & ".",
            "Every quick response helps protect a life. Thank you, " & vResponderName & ".",
            "Thank you for being part of the response network, " & vResponderName & ".",
            "Care delivered. Case completed. Great work, " & vResponderName & "."
        ],
        RandBetween(1, 6)
    ).Value
)
